name: Adıyaman

queries.query: Adıyaman Turkey cadastral parcel map official TKGM parcel query
queries.result: Official TKGM results identify Parsel Sorgu as the public cadastral parcel viewer and describe public parcel location, area, map-sheet, qualification, and coordinate access. An official Adıyaman municipal imar viewer was also found.

queries.query: Adıyaman Türkiye kadastro parsel sorgu resmi TKGM
queries.result: Resmî TKGM sonuçları Parsel Sorgu uygulamasını kamuya açık parsel sorgulama hizmeti olarak tanımlıyor. Adıyaman Belediyesi Kent Rehberi imar haritasında TKGM katmanı ve ada/parsel sorgu arayüzü gözlendi.

researchNote: The official national TKGM cadastral service was anonymously reachable and returned a safe polygon on a bounded nearby coordinate. The exact WUP point returned no parcel; that miss is not interpreted as citywide absence. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
